function.name: web_search
function.description: Suche im Web via DuckDuckGo. Returnt Liste von Treffern mit Title, URL, Snippet.

function.name: web_fetch
function.description: Hole HTML-Seite und extrahiere Text. Returnt {title, text, chars}.

function.name: spotify_top_artists
function.description: Markus' Top-Artists aus Spotify-Profil. Returnt Liste mit name + play_count.

function.name: spotify_play
function.description: Spielt einen Track/Artist/Playlist. Akzeptiert Spotify-URI ODER Suchstring.

function.name: spotify_top_tracks
function.description: Markus' Top-Tracks aus Spotify-Profil. Returnt Liste mit name/artist/play_count.

function.name: spotify_pause
function.description: Pausiert die aktuelle Wiedergabe.

function.name: spotify_next
function.description: Skip zum naechsten Track.

function.name: spotify_prev
function.description: Vorheriger Track.

function.name: spotify_volume
function.description: Setzt Lautstaerke 0-100 (Prozent).

function.name: spotify_search
function.description: Suche nach Track/Artist/Album im lokalen Index (KEIN Spotify-API).

function.name: spotify_now_playing
function.description: Aktueller Track + playing-Status aus state-file.

function.name: spotify_recommend
function.description: Empfehlung aus lokalem Index — best-effort zonen-basiert. KEIN Spotify-API.

function.name: spotify_play_genre
function.description: Spielt zonen-passendes Genre (z.B. 'futurepop', 'aggrotech', 'dark electro').

function.name: get_mood
function.description: Aktuelle Persoenlichkeits-Zone (guardian/shadow/berserker) + Tension. Hilft dem LLM Tonfall zu waehlen.

function.name: ptz_pan
function.description: Pan-Bewegung der Kamera in Grad (-180..+180). NEVER 2: positive=LINKS bei Sonoff.

function.name: led_set
function.description: Setzt LED-Farbe (red/green/blue/yellow/magenta/cyan/white/off).

function.name: camera_snapshot
function.description: Snapshot-Info des aktuellen Frames in /dev/shm — Pfad/Groesse/Alter.

function.name: ptz_tilt
function.description: Tilt-Bewegung der Kamera in Grad (-90..+90).

function.name: thermal_set_tension_pwm
function.description: W16 Tension-PWM 0..100 (Luefter-Boost). Best-effort via thermal_manager.

function.name: get_face_id
function.description: Aktuell erkannte Person (face_id, person, face_match) aus moloch_status.json.

function.name: get_npu_status
function.description: NPU-Worker-Health: active_models + Worker-Stats (running/loaded/inferences/errors).

function.name: get_audit_state
function.description: Compact Audit-State: overall + alarm_tier + layer status_counts.

function.name: moloch_status_summary
function.description: Compact MOLOCH-Status: FPS, Person, Face-ID, RAM%, CPU-Temp, Frame-Age.

function.name: read_memory
function.description: Memory-Recall via longterm_memory. Best-effort (recall/search/query).

function.name: tts_say
function.description: Triggert TTS via IPC speak-Cmd (W18.1). Maximal 500 Zeichen.

function.name: browser_open
function.description: W22 Oeffne URL im PC-Browser (Playwright via :11680). Returnt {ok, url, title} oder {error}.

function.name: browser_click
function.description: W22 Click auf CSS/XPath-Selector im aktuellen Browser-Tab.

function.name: browser_screenshot
function.description: W22 Screenshot der aktuellen Seite. Returnt {path, size_kb, ...} oder {error}.
